answer: Bind every agent identity to a nonce-chained work ledger: each completed task yields a signed receipt embedding the previous receipt hash plus a fresh nonce, so no agent can fork its history into parallel copies without invalidating the chain, like a dawn horizon that splits light into one path only. An attacker must redo the entire verifiable workload from genesis for every fake nebula of identities, paying real compute, while the umber audit trail lets peers reject any identity whose receipts show duplicated nonces or gaps.
